Keyboard Shortcut

        
Activate voice recording instantly from any active tab.

        

          

            Primary Shortcut:
            Ctrl + Shift + X (or ⌘ + Shift + X on Mac)
          

          

            To change or customize this keybinding in Chrome:
            

            1. Open a new tab and navigate to: chrome://extensions/shortcuts
            

            2. Locate Voice Bilingual Professionalizer.
            

            3. Click the pencil icon and press your desired shortcut key combination.
          

          

            Shift Browser users: Shift may reserve Ctrl+Shift+X for its own
            sidebar. If the shortcut does nothing in Shift, open Shift's own keyboard-shortcut settings and either free
            Ctrl+Shift+X or assign this extension a different combination via
            chrome://extensions/shortcuts. In Google Chrome the default binding works as-is.
          

        


        
        

          

            Local Speech AI — Recommended Browser Setup:
          

          

            1. Enable Graphics Acceleration — for better Local Speech AI and GPU-accelerated processing,
            make sure browser graphics acceleration is enabled:
            

            1. Open a new tab and navigate to: chrome://settings/system
            

            2. Enable "Use graphics acceleration when available".
            

            3. Relaunch the browser for the change to take effect.
          

          

            2. Verify WebGPU — Local Speech AI uses WebGPU for hardware-accelerated Whisper inference when
            supported (the extension detects this automatically; no experimental flags are required):
            

            1. Open a new tab and navigate to: chrome://gpu
            

            2. Check Graphics Feature Status — "WebGPU" should read
            Hardware accelerated ("Software only" still works via the automatic CPU/WASM fallback).
            

            3. Keep Hardware Acceleration on Auto-Detect in this page unless diagnostics indicate otherwise.
          

          

            3. Enable WebGPU support via flags (only if step 2 shows WebGPU unavailable):
            

            1. Open a new tab and navigate to: chrome://flags/
            

            2. Search for WebGPU and set #enable-unsafe-webgpu to Enabled.
            

            3. Relaunch the browser, then re-check chrome://gpu.
            

            Note: only do this when WebGPU is genuinely missing in your browser (some Chromium forks ship with it
            disabled) — the extension already uses feature detection, so no flag is needed in standard Chrome.
          

        

      


      
      

        
Privacy & Data Handling

        
    
          
  • Zero Session Scraping: We never inspect, collect, or scrape ChatGPT web cookies or account passwords.
    • 
          
  • Ephemeral Audio: Microphone audio is converted to text in-memory and immediately released. Zero audio is stored.
    • 
          
  • Local Storage: Your API keys are stored in Chrome's sandboxed local storage on your machine.
    •
